name: sticker_fly
description: A big sticker that flies across the top of the screen in about a second, leaving a trail - a rocket or an arrow shooting up, a heart, a star or a gift floating up. No words. For a burst of energy where the speaker talks about growth, a start, speed, launching or love; at most two in a video, never over other graphics.

icon.description: The sticker: rocket or arrow fly across; anything else floats up.
